archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / AUDIO CREATOR DATA COMMAND
target_audience: Solo music creators, independent artists, and music label managers running multi-artist rosters.

brand_identity.vibe: Audio-studio precision meets modern high-density analytics. Precision-engineered, tactical, trustworthy, and artist-first.
brand_identity.signature_feature: Release Race (Day-0-aligned trajectory comparison of releases across platforms)
brand_identity.core_workflow: Connect → Import → Snapshot → Analyse → Compare → Ask → Report
brand_identity.theme_strategy: Dual Mode (Light & Dark theme with instant toggle). Defaulting to Dark Mode for studio immersion, with high-contrast crisp Light Mode for executive reporting.

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

scale.label_caps: text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: High Density Grid (Mode B for Dashboards)

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/80 shadow-sm
visual_enhancers.pulse_indicator: relative flex h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500
visual_enhancers.stale_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20
visual_enhancers.reconnect_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/20

navigation_header.description: Sticky top bar containing logo, Workspace/Profile switcher dropdown, search bar, last-synced status timer, theme toggle, and private beta badge.
navigation_header.background: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#090D16]/90 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800

workspace_switcher.description: Dropdown selector for managers to switch between individual artists (e.g., 'Luna Eclipse', 'Aether Pulse Studio') or combined Label Workspace view.

release_race_signature_chart.description: Day-0 normalized timeline comparison chart built with Recharts LineChart. Aligns multiple releases from their respective Day 0 launch date up to Day 90. Features toggles for metrics (Streams, Saves, Playlist Reach, TikTok Creation count) and normalization modes.
release_race_signature_chart.interactivity: Hover sync, curve smoothing, day range filter buttons (Day 7, 14, 30, 90, All).

ai_analyst_qa_panel.description: Grounding AI Chat component ('Ask Xoba AI'). Prompts users with suggested questions grounded in backend metrics ('Why did Spotify streams spike on Day 14?', 'Compare YouTube retention rate between Release A and B'). Displays confidence tag, data source citations, and chart snapshot embeds.
ai_analyst_qa_panel.layout: Right drawer or expandable panel with quick prompt chips.

platform_connections.description: Cards showing connection state for Spotify for Artists, YouTube Analytics, Apple Music for Artists, TikTok, Instagram, and CSV Sync. Features status indicators: 'Connected', 'Syncing', 'Needs Reconnect', 'Needs Auth'.
platform_connections.actions: Connect OAuth, Trigger Manual Refresh, Manage CSV Upload.

csv_upload_flow.description: Interactive drag-and-drop CSV importer with field mapping step (Song Title, ISRC/UPC, Date, Streams, Revenue, Country) and preview table before snapshot commit.

reports_exporter.description: Export modal allowing PNG snapshot, PDF deck generation, or password-protected public share link creation.

testing_requirements.naming_convention: kebab-case role-based attributes (e.g. data-testid="release-race-chart", data-testid="workspace-switcher-trigger", data-testid="platform-card-spotify", data-testid="ai-chat-input", data-testid="theme-toggle-button")

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement React components in plain JavaScript/JSX files (.js/.jsx) as requested by project environment rules.
Ensure both Light and Dark themes work seamlessly using Tailwind 'dark' class toggling stored in state/localStorage.
Make the Release Race chart prominent and interactive using Recharts with Day-0 alignment toggle.
Always provide data-testid attributes on key interactive components for automated verification.
Never hide essential header or workspace controls behind responsive menus on desktop viewports.
